pages.lesson:
LESSON: JOHN THE BAPTIST TO THE MESSIAH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.2: John the Baptist to the Messiah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on John the Baptist to the Messiah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is John the Baptist a precursor to the Messiah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss the message of John the Baptist in Luke 3:7-18
2. apply values acquired from the teachings of John the Baptist in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: JOHN THE BAPTIST TO THE MESSIAH
This lesson teaches John the Baptist to the Messiah for Grade 7 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. discuss the message of John the Baptist in Luke 3:7-18
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply values acquired from the teachings of John the Baptist in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe John the Baptist to the Messiah using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about John the Baptist to the Messiah above.
2. Explain John the Baptist to the Messiah to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand John the Baptist to the Messiah.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about John the Baptist to the Messiah with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is John the Baptist to the Messiah important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is John the Baptist a precursor to the Messiah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. discuss the message of John the Baptist in Luke 3:7-18
2. apply values acquired from the teachings of John the Baptist in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
